narration: Quarters up. TheReads versus OptionSelect — winner keeps the stick warm.
Chairs scrape closer. Everybody wants to see this.
The bars flash full and the first game is live.
A whiffed Standing Jab. No damage, no harm — except OptionSelect now knows it's in there.
OptionSelect whiff punishes Heavy Starter on reaction — 429, and it was free the moment TheReads pressed it.
TheReads lands the poke and hesitates on the follow-up. 135, when it could have been the round.
TheReads walks OptionSelect into the corner and dumps them there — 431.
TheReads clips OptionSelect for 148. The full route was there. The execution wasn't.
TheReads goes upstairs — Jumping Arc has to be blocked standing and OptionSelect was crouching. 409.
TheReads doesn't reach for anything fancy — a 4f Standing Jab for 17 is all that's left to do, to bank game one.
They run it back. Game 2. TheReads walks in with a full bar banked.
TheReads gets in behind Standing Jab — +2 on block — and simply does not leave.
TheReads resets the pressure. 153 more off the top, and OptionSelect still hasn't had a turn.
OptionSelect guesses right for once, and TheReads is the one on the back foot.
TheReads touches with Standing Jab — it confirms. 155.
— Step Feint! Another 124.
— and Grand Finale CLOSES it. 100 to finish — 379 off one touch.
A whiffed Throw. No damage, no harm — except OptionSelect now knows it's in there.
OptionSelect touches with Standing Jab — it confirms. 171.
— Step Feint keeps it rolling: 137.
— Grand Finale for the ender. 112, 420 in all, and the room hears it.
Three guesses from TheReads, three right answers from OptionSelect. The guard holds.
TheReads snatches OptionSelect up and slams them down — 392.
OptionSelect lands the poke and hesitates on the follow-up. 140, when it could have been the round.
TheReads has the first hits of the Bread and Butter scouted — blocked, blocked, still blocked…
— then Spiral Knuckle slips in LOW under the block and it's open —
— Standing Jab lands clean: 110 —
— into Step Feint. 88 more.
— and Grand Finale CLOSES it. 71 to finish — 269 off one touch.
TheReads walks OptionSelect into the corner and dumps them there — 216.
TheReads sweeps it 2–0. Total control from the character select screen.

narration: Quarters up. JohnnySalt versus NeutralSkip — winner keeps the stick warm.
The bars flash full and the first game is live.
JohnnySalt gets in behind Standing Jab — +2 on block — and simply does not leave.
JohnnySalt resets the pressure. 176 more off the top, and NeutralSkip still hasn't had a turn.
NeutralSkip finds the gap in the string and takes their turn back.
NeutralSkip rolls Sonic Edge along the floor — JohnnySalt can't crouch under that one — 4 of them, 274 shaved off.
The hit lands — Jumping Arc, 238, and NeutralSkip's hands are already moving.
— and Big Bang Encore CLOSES it. 190 to finish — 428 off one touch.
JohnnySalt gets the hit but can't find the confirm — 149 and the moment passes.
Low. Sweep catches NeutralSkip standing for 490.
Spiral Knuckle slips in under the guard. 411, and now NeutralSkip has to guess all over again.
One more poke. 74. That's all it needed to be, to bank game one.
Game 2. Fresh bars, same tension — 1–0 in the set.

narration: NeutralSkip and MashPro step up. The cabinet hums.
The bars flash full and the first game is live.
MashPro stands exactly where Spiral Knuckle reaches and NeutralSkip doesn't. 370, and nothing NeutralSkip has can answer from there.
NeutralSkip sends Sonic Edge skidding low and MashPro has to deal with it standing — 5 of them, 283 shaved off.
NeutralSkip sits down on the block, and MashPro was waiting for it: Jumping Arc overhead, 430.
Three guesses from NeutralSkip, three right answers from MashPro. The guard holds.
NeutralSkip rolls Sonic Edge along the floor — MashPro can't crouch under that one — 3 of them, 359 shaved off.
MashPro presses in. NeutralSkip's guard takes the first two clean. Stalemate for half a second…
— then MashPro goes OVER the top: Jumping Arc, and the guard cracks open —
— Quick Poke lands clean: 188 —
— into Throw. 150 more.
— and Grand Finale CLOSES it. 122 to finish — 460 off one touch.
No route needed. Standing Jab, 40, and that's the bar, and takes the opener.
They run it back. Game 2.
NeutralSkip takes centre screen and puts Sonic Edge on a metronome. There is no way to MashPro that isn't through it.
MashPro creeps forward behind a block and eats 4 more on the way in — 158.
And then MashPro is just… there. Point blank, past the wall, and the whole room exhales. NeutralSkip's turn is over.
Pure spacing — Spiral Knuckle catches NeutralSkip at the tip, 208, and MashPro strolls back out of range.
Throw comes out at nothing. MashPro is stuck in it, and NeutralSkip is already moving.
Blocked. Sky Piercer is -18 and MashPro has known that all night: 321.
NeutralSkip clips MashPro for 146. The full route was there. The execution wasn't.
NeutralSkip fills the entire screen with Big Bang Encore! 386 damage.
NeutralSkip sends Sonic Edge skidding low and MashPro has to deal with it standing — 3 of them, 182 shaved off.
MashPro unloads Grand Finale in one long unbroken barrage! 341 damage.
NeutralSkip touches with Jumping Arc — it confirms. 109.
— into Sweep. 88 more.
— Seismic Slam for the ender. 71, 268 in all, and the room hears it, evening the set at 1–1.
Final game. Match point both ways. The whole arcade holds its breath.
NeutralSkip rolls Sonic Edge along the floor — MashPro can't crouch under that one — 3 of them, 214 shaved off.
MashPro lunges in with Spiral Knuckle from further out than NeutralSkip expected — 273.
MashPro grabs NeutralSkip and puts them straight on the floor — 374.
NeutralSkip sends Sonic Edge skidding low and MashPro has to deal with it standing — 3 of them, 281 shaved off.
NeutralSkip rolls Sonic Edge along the floor — MashPro can't crouch under that one — 6 of them, 246 shaved off.
NeutralSkip presses in. MashPro's guard takes the first two clean. Stalemate for half a second…
— then NeutralSkip goes OVER the top: Seismic Slam, and the guard cracks open —
— Jumping Arc lands clean: 209 —
— and Big Bang Encore CLOSES it. 168 to finish — 377 off one touch.
NeutralSkip walks MashPro into the corner and takes the last 22 with a single button.
Last hit lands — NeutralSkip escapes the set 2–1 with 50% left!
NeutralSkip stands up: "Too easy!"

TopEight leads the lifetime series 8–3.
The bars flash full and the first game is live.
TopEight gets in behind Reaper Arc — +2 on block — and simply does not leave.
AL | InstantAir blocks the string and takes 131 in chip for the privilege.
AL | InstantAir tries to escape and finds the exit is also covered.
TopEight snatches AL | InstantAir up and slams them down — 293.
A clean touch for TopEight, but the hands don't answer — 119 and back to neutral.
The hit lands — Standing Jab, 141, and TopEight's hands are already moving.
— Pommel Check keeps it rolling: 113.
— and Executioner's Mark CLOSES it. 91 to finish — 345 off one touch.
AL | InstantAir clips TopEight for 112. The full route was there. The execution wasn't.
Three guesses from AL | InstantAir, three right answers from TopEight. The guard holds.
AL | InstantAir lands the poke and hesitates on the follow-up. 126, when it could have been the round.
AL | InstantAir inches forward, TopEight inches back. Neither wants to press first.
The hit lands — Standing Jab, 133, and AL | InstantAir's hands are already moving.
— Pommel Check keeps it rolling: 106.
— and Executioner's Mark CLOSES it. 86 to finish — 325 off one touch.
AL | InstantAir clips TopEight for 124. The full route was there. The execution wasn't.
AL | InstantAir punishes TopEight for existing three feet too close — 207 over the exchange.
AL | InstantAir doesn't reach for anything fancy — a 7f Standing Jab for 61 is all that's left to do.
TopEight doesn't reach for anything fancy — a 7f Standing Jab for 81 is all that's left to do.
TopEight doesn't reach for anything fancy — a 7f Standing Jab for 31 is all that's left to do, to bank game one.
They run it back. Game 2. TopEight walks in with a full bar banked.
TopEight sits down behind the block and reads every layer of it. AL | InstantAir backs off to rethink.
TopEight winds up Halberd Line and everyone in the room sees it coming — it lands anyway — 347.
TopEight sticks Low Sweep Blade out and AL | InstantAir runs into it — 309.
AL | InstantAir walks TopEight into the corner and dumps them there — 261.
AL | InstantAir catches TopEight clean and Executioner's Mark takes over the whole screen! 360 damage.
Sweep slips in under the guard. 308, and now AL | InstantAir has to guess all over again.
No route needed. Standing Jab, 36, and that's the bar.
That's the set — TopEight wins 2–0.
TopEight stands up: "Don't blink."
TiltProof and BL | FrameTrap run the customary button check, then it's on.
TiltProof leads the lifetime series 3–2.
Character select locks in. Round one.
TiltProof presses in. BL | FrameTrap's guard takes the first two clean. Stalemate for half a second…
— so TiltProof just THROWS them out of block: Throw — wide open —
— Standing Jab lands clean: 145 —
— Step Feint! Another 116.
— Grand Finale for the ender. 94, 355 in all, and the room hears it.
BL | FrameTrap gets the hit but can't find the confirm — 144 and the moment passes.
TiltProof stands exactly where Spiral Knuckle reaches and BL | FrameTrap doesn't. 323, and nothing BL | FrameTrap has can answer from there.
TiltProof starts the string and BL | FrameTrap BLOCKS it — one hit, two, patient behind the guard…
— then Spiral Knuckle slips in LOW under the block and it's open —
— Quick Poke lands clean: 131 —
— Throw! Another 105.
— and Grand Finale CLOSES it. 86 to finish — 322 off one touch, and takes the opener.

BL | FrameTrap reaches for Standing Jab from way too far out. It whiffs through empty air and TiltProof just… watches it.
BL | FrameTrap steps in, gets clipped by Spiral Knuckle on the way, and pays 201 for the ground.
The overhead. Jumping Arc comes down over the guard for 332 — BL | FrameTrap guessed high when it mattered.
The overhead. Jumping Arc comes down over the guard for 369 — TiltProof guessed high when it mattered.

BL | FrameTrap shows TiltProof one form and beats them with the other — 322 over the exchange.

— into Closed Guard. 132 more.
— and Both Hands CLOSES it. 107 to finish — 404 off one touch.
BL | FrameTrap walks TiltProof into the corner and takes the last 45 with a single button, evening the set at 1–1.
Final game. Match point both ways. The whole arcade holds its breath.
TiltProof gets in behind Standing Jab — +2 on block — and simply does not leave.
TiltProof resets the pressure. 126 more off the top, and BL | FrameTrap still hasn't had a turn.
BL | FrameTrap mashes at the gap that isn't there. TiltProof keeps the turn.
Blocked. Zenith Cutter is -18 and BL | FrameTrap has known that all night: 403.
TiltProof blocks it all — the round slows to a staring contest at half screen.
Sweep slips in under the guard. 225, and now TiltProof has to guess all over again.
BL | FrameTrap unloads Both Hands in one long unbroken barrage! 330 damage.
TiltProof runs BL | FrameTrap down and cashes the bar with Grand Finale! 326 damage.
Pure spacing — Spiral Knuckle catches BL | FrameTrap at the tip, 256, and TiltProof strolls back out of range.
TiltProof stands exactly where Spiral Knuckle reaches and BL | FrameTrap doesn't. 292, and nothing BL | FrameTrap has can answer from there.
TiltProof clutches the decider 2–1. What a set.
TiltProof stands up: "Absolutely free."
